section_summary.extract_value: This section describes Study 1, a longitudinal investigation examining biopsychosocial determinants of weight gain among first-year college women. Ninety-four White female adolescents (aged 17-19) admitted to a southeastern U.S. university were recruited via mail and electronic invitations to complete an online survey during the summer before college enrollment. After excluding 10 participants with missing data, the final sample consisted of 84 participants (mean age = 17.9 years, mean BMI = 22.7, self-reported).
